description: What the window is allowed to do. Custom commands in generate_handler are permitted by Tauri without being listed here; the core event channel is NOT, and leaving it out is silent — invoke keeps working while every listen() is refused, so the app spawns the run and then renders nothing. THE WINDOW PERMISSIONS ARE THE SAME TRAP, and cost a shipped build: taking the border off means the app has to close, minimise and drag itself, and every one of those calls is denied unless named here. Mark, 2026-08-26: 'the x in the top left doesn't close the app after the border was removed.' It threw nothing a user could see — the button simply did nothing, on a window that no longer had a system close button to fall back on.
